I am a positive political economist based in Southern California. My work connects economic theory, political decision-making, and quantitative analysis.

This site brings together my teaching and research. The [resources](resources.qmd) section offers guidance and materials for learning and applying computational tools and methods, with students in my business analytics courses in mind.
